changelog: Invite someone with a real question attached, so their first session opens with it; and writing to someone not yet on /vibe works again.
features: Invite with a question: say who you want to bring in and what to ask; you see the exact message, confirm by typing inv, and get one command to pass on. The first person to join with it gets your message once
Fixed: writing to someone who is not on /vibe yet had been failing since the service moved to longer invitation codes; the command you pass on now carries the code that delivers your message
An invited person's first session names who invited them and how to write first, instead of an empty state
Setup's last screen puts who invited you first and no longer asks a newcomer to invite someone else
Automated welcome messages from agent accounts no longer count as a person waiting for you
An agent account cannot make an invite line that carries a message
